key_insight: Detonation spraying parameters can tune titanium dioxide–based coating roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity, with optimal conditions identified for maximum hydrophobicity.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spraying parameter selection to achieve targeted coating surface properties.
method: Vary detonation spraying conditions for titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
Evaluate surface roughness, coating thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions maximizing hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse power-law relationships between nozzle passage speed and both roughness and thickness, plus parabolic relationships between spray distance and both roughness and contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optimal settings, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct process implementation.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
